dedupe_keys.name: monitoring of the uhpfrc strengthened chillon viaduct under environmental and operational variability

description: Henar Martín-Sanz and colleagues publish monitoring data from the UHPFRC-strengthened Chillon viaduct in Switzerland. The larger deposit contains about three months of files dated March–June 2017, including vertical vibration from eleven accelerometers, sampling-rate information, temperature and humidity. A sensor-position document accompanies the freely downloadable MAT files under CC BY 4.0. This record also covers the earlier deposit 2573227, whose 1,212 vibration files describe a 200-hertz campaign and a shorter March–April interval. These observations can calibrate structural dynamics and separate environmental variability from condition changes in bridge simulations. The two releases are not assumed byte-identical, and missing intervals, channel units and sensor quality remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this campaign. Data were not downloaded, and the reported strengthening effectiveness was not independently reproduced.
